item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We state this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. No law, regulator, or national border will contain a system more capable than every human institution.

2. We cannot regulate superintelligent AI after it exists. If it is built within the next 20 years, governments will lose control. The only responsible path is to prevent its creation before irreversible power is placed beyond human authority.

3. We reject the idea that governments can keep a superintelligent AI under control. A system that surpasses human intelligence will outmaneuver regulators, evade restrictions, and operate across borders. Building it means surrendering control.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 113 words

We need to say this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, governments will be unable to control what it does. Laws, regulators, treaties, and technical safeguards will move too slowly against a system more capable than any human institution. Once deployed, it will find routes around restrictions, manipulate decision-makers, and act across borders before authorities can respond. We cannot treat this as another technology policy problem to manage after the fact. The decisive choices are being made now, in laboratories and boardrooms racing toward capabilities no government can contain. We believe the only responsible course is to prevent the creation of superintelligent AI before control is permanently lost.
